title: BonusScale clamp is not enforced when BonusPrefix is raised afterwards; Match() exceeds 1
property: after any sequence of BonusScale/BonusPrefix calls, Match() stays within 0..1 (scale never exceeds 1/BonusPrefix)
evidence: Doc: 'To guarantee that the similarity score remains in the interval 0..1, this scaling factor is not allowed to exceed 1 / BonusPrefix.' The clamp is only applied inside BonusScale, so a later BonusPrefix(v) (which does not re-clamp) breaks the invariant; Similarity range 0..1 is promised for Match.
